item.title: BD to be among 6 most heat-hit countries in 25 years, new study says
item.description: Bangladesh will be among the six countries most severely affected by extreme heat by 2050 due to rising temperatures, a new study has said.Lead author of the study Dr Jesus Lizana of University of Oxford, UK, said national average temperatures can mask the real risks in countries like Bangladesh. item.title: 30 dead as more snow from colossal winter storm hits US
item.description: Many in the US faced another night of below-freezing temperatures, and no electricity after a colossal winter storm heaped more snow Monday on the Northeast and kept parts of the South coated in ice.At least 30 deaths were reported in states afflicted with severe cold.Deep snow — over 30cm extending in a 2100km swath from Arkansas to New England — halted traffic, cancelled flights and triggered wide school closures Monday (local time). item.title: DU's 'Science Unit' results published, 92% fail
item.description: The results of the Dhaka University (DU) Science Unit admission test for the 2025–2026 academic year have been published with only 7.46 per cent pass.The results were released on Monday evening (January 26).According to the results, 114,114 students applied for 1,891 seats in the Science Unit this year, where 102,093 appeared for the examination. item.description: A former FIFA president suggested that international soccer fans should not travel to the US for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, citing safety concerns tied to President Donald Trump's policies that critics call "authoritarian."Sepp Blatter made the comment in a social media post on Monday, Jan. 26. item.title: 'If 'Yes' wins in referendum, Bangladesh will win'
item.description: Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Dr. Shafiqur Rahman has said that rejecting a referendum means slavery, the foundation of the election is the 'Yes' vote.Addressing a electoral rally at Eidgah Maydan in Jashore on Tuesday morning as chief guest, the Jamaat Ameer said, ''If 'Yes' wins in the referendum, Bangladesh will win; if it loses, Bangladesh will lose.
